## Outcome

Describe the observable result and the current defect or missing capability.

## Scope

Name the relevant modules, handoff documents, and any overlapping work.

## Acceptance checks

List the evidence/tests required to call this complete.

## Authorization boundary

Default: local source and synthetic tests only. No vendor execution, production writes, credentials,
real profiles or leases. Any exception needs separate explicit owner authorization.

## Handoff

Link the working branch/PR and record what is implemented, tested and still unknown.
